start_basis: clock tool captured immediately before concrete native-library experiment setup
excluded: Earlier read-only feasibility/API investigation preceded this timestamp and is not measured by this interval.
interpretation: A bounded implementation-phase wall interval, including tools and waits; not active authoring time, human/person-hours or a complete end-to-end effort measure.
allocation_reason: Raw conversion, shared lemma and combined workflow work are shared and were not separately timed. No arbitrary split.
